about_the_game:
This idle desktop companion runs quietly in the background while you work, giving you a fun and relaxing way to build your ultimate monster collection.

Hatch. Evolve. Collect!

Hatch, feed and play with your monsters to evolve them into their final, most impressive forms. Each monster you evolve is a new entry in your Codex. Can you collect them all?

Discover Evo Items

Not all monsters evolve the same way. Some need special Evo Items to trigger their transformations. Discover which item works with which monster.

Share your Favourite Moments

Got a rare egg? Evolved a monster into a special form? Use the built-in screenshot tool to snap and share your favourite moments with friends and the community.

Flexible Settings

Customise how the game behaves - Keep it tucked behind your windows, or bring it to the front. Switch the game to another monitor, change the colour scheme and more.

Whether you're grinding through emails or gaming on the side, your monster collection continues to grow.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
